text:
maria: Quick sync — final announce copy is ready but we need the canonical changelog and docs links to include in the post. Target send window Wed 10:00 PT. Can eng confirm the changelog URL and whether anything major will land before then? Also want to confirm webinar CTA (slot B) and benchmark numbers to highlight.

kevin: Thanks — tagging @oliver and @devon for rollout timing. No high-risk changes expected, but there's a small perf tweak in review that could land today. If it does, numbers may shift slightly.

oliver: I can publish what's live now: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v1.3.0 and the changelog canonical URL I have is https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/releases/tag/v1.3.0. If kevin's PR merges I will patch the docs and add a header note.

kevin: FYI PR #3214 is in review, looks safe — could merge by EOD. If merged: rough bench uplift ~+7% tokens/sec on prod-like chat workloads.

kevin: Repro command (dev bench): `python benchmarks/run.py --model redwood-7b --seq 512 --batch 8`

devon: If that lands, marketing please use conservative language. Suggest: 'up to 7% faster serving on common chat workloads' — avoid absolute claims until we have 24h of metrics.

sara: From growth: inbound routing — we need webinar signups to be tagged so Sales gets them routed correctly. Can Platform confirm `lead_source=release_webinar_v1_3` will be present in the webhook payload?

platform-bot: Deploy scheduled: rolling prod deploy 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC (3h window). Canary first 15m. Details: https://deploys.redwood.ai/12345

kevin: Deploy window ok. I'll add the `lead_source` field to the webhook payload and push a small schema change. Oliver — can you add UTM tags to the docs CTA? `?utm_campaign=release_v1_3_webinar`

oliver: Done — docs CTA now includes the UTM. Also set the changelog link to redirect if the tag is force-updated; I'll add a tiny note at top of the doc.

maria: Great — last asks before I schedule the post: (1) final changelog link to paste in the announcement (2) final webinar CTA link (3) approved marquee benchmark phrasing. If all green I’ll queue the post for Wed 10:00 PT.

kevin: Final changelog (canonical): https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/releases/tag/v1.3.0
kevin: Webinar CTA: https://redwood.ai/webinar/v1-3?slot=B&utm_medium=marketing
kevin: Marquee phrasing approved per devon: "up to 7% faster serving on common chat workloads"

maria: Perfect — scheduling now. Sara, I opened routing ticket #542 for Sales Ops to wire the `lead_source` -> Sales Queue mapping. cc @oliver @kevin :thumbsup:

oliver: will post a tiny docs note after the merge if needed.

kevin: I'll monitor the PR and update if anything unexpected shows.

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll share the final scheduled post URL once queued. :rocket:
